name: How do I choose the right design for my primary-residence tiny home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right design for my primary-residence tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right design involves evaluating your lifestyle, space needs, and aesthetic preferences. Consider the number of occupants, daily routines, storage requirements, and any specific features you desire, such as a dedicated workspace or a larger kitchen. Reviewing floor plans, material options, and exterior styles can help narrow down choices. Our design team works with you to customize a plan that maximizes functionality and comfort within the tiny home footprint, while also ensuring it meets local building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a design by considering your lifestyle, space needs, and aesthetic preferences, ensuring it maximizes functionality and meets local building codes.
